decisions.reason: Confirmed a defining-relation logic defect: the old Definition fixes only the core crossing and the smoothing framings. An extra full twist in a crossing ribbon relative to its endpoint bands changes the framed-link class while preserving those specified data. The repair specifies untwisted blackboard framing for all three local tangles and matching framed endpoint collars; it preserves the ring, endpoint pairings, coefficients, empty link, and zero-framed circle relation.
